svg.text: GENERATORS — anything that outputs a trajectory
v1 was a fixed pipeline: Sensing → Perception → Localization → Planning. Transparent, and easy to collaborate on.
But an end-to-end model skips stages, so it could not be hosted at all. The strength and the weakness were the same property.
v2 abstracts the front half away. A black-box planner may run — but only behind an explicit safety gate.
The cost: with several generators competing, “why did the car do that?” gets harder. Flexibility traded for diagnosability.
Source: Autoware Documentation, “Autoware 2.0 Architecture” (marked Under Construction).
